verdict.rationale: Grafana ships AI features such as Grafana Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only shows the reverse direction: Grafana exposing its own MCP server for outside agents to connect to. Nothing documents Grafana or its Assistant plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, so the server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
